bullets.title: Butternut 2013 Chardonnay
bullets.note:
\-- I’m a red wine guy. There are very few white wines that make me defect.
The first I met was a [2004 Rombauer
Chardonnay](http://www.fourhournewsletter.com/click.html?x=a62e&lc=wBP&mc=e&s=bomwH&u=w&y=n&).
The most recent is this delicious Butternut 2013. Every person at the table --
all self-described red-wine people -- loved it and remarked upon it. If those
both sell out, try some of my current favorite sake, [Hitori
Musume](http://www.fourhournewsletter.com/click.html?x=a62e&lc=wB7&mc=e&s=bomwH&u=w&y=V&).
